title: [GMCP 203.039.01] Contract: Server supervision and lifecycle orchestration
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-039-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: A durable supervisor starts servers in dependency order, health-checks readiness and liveness, applies bounded restart/backoff/quarantine, drains and reloads without losing admitted work, propagates cancellation, reaps process trees and exposes exact state/reason. Boot storms, crash loops, hangs, upgrades, resource exhaustion and host restart converge automatically without duplicate instances or silent capability loss. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
